runs.name: desktop
runs.dialogAria:
- dialog "Profile photo":
  - banner:
    - heading "Profile photo" [level=2]
    - button "Close photo editor"
  - paragraph: Drag the circle to position it. Drag a corner to resize.
  - group "Crop position":
    - slider "Resize crop from top left"
    - slider "Resize crop from top right"
    - slider "Resize crop from bottom left"
    - slider "Resize crop from bottom right"

  - contentinfo:
    - button "Reset"
    - button "Cancel"
    - button "Save photo"
